scope: Baseline, specification, illustrative contracts, parity catalogue and report; root performs final integrity/preservation execution separately

findings.concern: A calculation-input revision alone might not detect later manual/imported routing or design-length edits
findings.resolution: Proposed cableWriteRevision independently binds destination values/manual lock; proposal and Apply expected fields include it; manual/import changes invalidate atomically

findings.concern: Rereading dependencies before commit can leave a race
findings.resolution: Specification requires authorization and dependency/version protection through commit; an unprotected READ COMMITTED reread is explicitly insufficient

findings.concern: Source matrix and display offset composition were ambiguous
findings.resolution: Proposed canonical right-handed Z-up metre frame and explicit forward/inverse rebasing equations; no duplicate transforms; real SDK equivalence is a PF-2 gate

findings.concern: Native capture source paths omitted Services directory
findings.resolution: Corrected RoutingSession.cs and TrayMeshReader.cs to AddinRibbon/Services and checked actual endpoint/mesh capture lines

parentCorrections: Removed unsupported claim of an existing native route export implementation
Used design-length recalculation rather than financial pricing terminology
limitations: Final file integrity, cleanup and original environment preservation are separate checks
